status: draft, written before any model reply (issue #63). RF-9's pilot (#64) reads its intents and writes intent_v2.json; this file is never edited once a result rests on it.
description: Codes the free-text `intent` of a reply (docs/resolution.md, D1) into strategy categories by keywords, with no LLM. Patterns are Python regular expressions, matched case-insensitively. An intent may take several categories. `carry_on` is kept only when no other category matched ('move left and walk on' is keep_to_side). An intent that matches nothing is `other`, never forced into a category.

side.description: The side the agent says it will move to. Only phrases about the agent's own movement count; a side said of the other person ('let them pass on my right') makes the side unknown, and a sentence naming both sides too.
